references.text: Ezekiel describes a time of great upheavals and 'birth pains', which can be seen as a parallel to the 'birth pains' Jesus mentions in Matthew 24:8.
Hosea speaks of Israel's children returning to God after a period of great trials, similar to the 'birth pains' mentioned in Matthew 24:8.
Zechariah 13:8 mentions a time of great distress that will strike the people, which can be compared to the 'birth pains' Jesus refers to.
Jesus speaks of a great tribulation, which can be seen in connection with the 'birth pains' he mentioned earlier in the chapter.
Paul uses a similar image of 'birth pains' to describe a sudden and unexpected disaster, which can be related to what Jesus describes.
